rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Turn 3 Phase 1 4 Phase 2 5 Phase 3 6 Phase 4 7 Scoring Overview Be the first to receive four rewards Turn Each round has 4 phases followed by scoring, players are aiming to keep cards which have objectives they feel are obtainable Phase 1 FIVE chips are added to the first zone Each player discards TWO objectives in hand, these will NOT be scored Phase 2 FOUR chips are added to the second zone Each player discards ONE objective in hand, this will NOT be scored Phase 3 THREE chips are added to the third zone Each player places TWO objectives facedown on the RIGHT of their discard pile and ONE objective facedown on the LEFT of their discard pile Once everyone have placed, these cards are flipped faceup Any objectives which are impossible to complete are discarded immediately Phase 4 TWO chips are added to the fourth zone Any objectives which are now impossible to complete are discarded Scoring Objectives which remain on the RIGHT of your discard pile give you POSITIVE points Objectives which remain on the LEFT of your discard pile give you NEGATIVE points The difference between your positive and negative is your score The player with the highest score gains 2 Rewards (if tied, 2 Rewards each and no 2nd place) The player with the 2nd highest gains 1 Reward (if tied, 1 Reward each) If someone now has 4 Rewards, end game is triggered Otherwise, reset for another round If end game was triggered, the player with the most rewards at the end of that round wins! (it's possible to have 5 Rewards) If tied, the player who won the end round wins!

[Rating: 3/10] The great design and party game aspect got me to buy the game, but after just one playthrough, I had enough.  It is just too simple and luck dependent, that sometimes I am not sure how I or other players won, so it is really mindless and it wears off its novelty fast.  Thankfully, it is not expensive to begin with, it does not take a lot of room to store, and it is quick to play, but I sincerely hope nobody buys this.  Frankly, it is just a waste of money, as the gameplay is terribly constructed, and there is no way to fix it.
